title: On Hiring a boy for the harvest
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：hire　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hire 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the director ① hired a boy for the harvest with great care, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② hires a boy for the harvest on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hire a boy for the harvest at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hired a boy for the harvest before — a line in the poster for August 1950 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hiring a boy for the harvest with great care, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hire a mule for the whole week on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hire a mule for the whole week at once and never mention it again.

By 1963 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ hires a mule for the whole week with great care every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hired a boy for the harvest again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hire a boy for the harvest, my mother said in 1968, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody hires a boy for the harvest on the same day again and somebody must hire a boy for the harvest with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 雇用（一般过去式 hired a boy for the harvest：1956 年导演头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 雇用（一般现在 hires a boy for the harvest：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 雇用（不定式 to hire a boy for the harvest：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 雇用（过去完成时 had hired a boy for the harvest：1950 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 雇用（动名词 hiring a boy for the harvest 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 租用（hire a mule for the whole week：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去租用租一整周的骡子）
G. v. 租用（hire a mule for the whole week：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 雇用（后段两处：新来的演员照例 hires a mule for the whole week，而母亲又一次 hired a boy for the harvest）

hire 意为“雇用”，结尾那句是母亲 1968 年的话：要雇用雇一个男孩来收庄稼，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hire 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the director hired a boy for the harvest with great care, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director hires a boy for the harvest on the same day whenever the theatre asks.
Hiring a boy for the harvest with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hire a mule for the whole week on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre hires a mule for the whole week with great care every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hired a boy for the harvest again, and the theatre remembered that half.
